pinyin: zhè fēng xìn shì péng you xiě de , nà zhāng tú piàn shì lǎo shī fā de .
meaning: This letter was written by a friend; that image was sent by the teacher.

text: 我去问主办方，再发短信告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ qù wèn zhǔ bàn fāng , zài fā duǎn xìn gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I will ask the organizer, then text you.

text: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
pinyin: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
meaning: We go happily to meet our friends.

text: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
meaning: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

pinyin: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
meaning: That green one is relatively light.

text: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié yòu zhòng yòu guì , wǒ jīn tiān bù chuān .
meaning: These shoes are both heavy and expensive; I will not wear them today.

text: 这个样子又可爱又自然。
pinyin: zhè gè yàng zi yòu kě ài yòu zì rán .
meaning: This look is both cute and natural.

pinyin: liǎng wàn shì èr shí gè yī qiān .
meaning: Twenty thousand is twenty thousands.

text: 一亿是一万万，不是一百万。
pinyin: yī yì shì yī wàn wàn , bù shì yī bǎi wàn .
meaning: One hundred million is ten thousand ten-thousands, not one million.

text: 活动一个多小时，不是十多个小时。
pinyin: huó dòng yī gè duō xiǎo shí , bù shì shí duō gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: The activity lasts a little over an hour, not more than ten hours.

text: 水果三斤多，钱一百多块，先问具体是多少。
pinyin: shuǐ guǒ sān jīn duō , qián yī bǎi duō kuài , xiān wèn jù tǐ shì duō shao .
meaning: The fruit is a little over three jin and the cost over a hundred yuan; ask for exact amounts.

text: 一封信，一件衣服，一条围巾。
pinyin: yī fēng xìn , yī jiàn yī fú , yī tiáo wéi jīn .
meaning: A letter, an item of clothing, a scarf.

pinyin: zhè wèi lǎo shī shōu dào liǎng fēng xìn .
meaning: This teacher received two letters.

text: 我给她一支笔，包裹送到学校。
pinyin: wǒ gěi tā yī zhī bǐ , bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào .
meaning: I give her a pen; the parcel is delivered to the school.

text: 他学了两年汉语，在这里住三天。
pinyin: tā xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ , zài zhè lǐ zhù sān tiān .
meaning: He has studied Chinese for two years and stays here for three days.

text: 一周以后再见，下周还有节目。
pinyin: yī zhōu yǐ hòu zài jiàn , xià zhōu hái yǒu jié mù .
meaning: See you a week later; there is another programme next week.

text: 开场以前先坐好，散场以后再出去。
pinyin: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān zuò hǎo , sàn chǎng yǐ hòu zài chū qù .
meaning: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看有没有车。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: Have tea after the show; check transport before going home.

text: 快要七点了，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: It is nearly seven; the programme is about to begin.

text: 下周就要放假了，不是已经放假了。
pinyin: xià zhōu jiù yào fàng jià le , bù shì yǐ jīng fàng jià le .
meaning: The holiday starts next week; it has not already begun.

text: 这里更安静，十分舒服，特别适合读书，挺好的。
pinyin: zhè lǐ gèng ān jìng , shí fēn shū fú , tè bié shì hé dú shū , tǐng hǎo de .
meaning: It is quieter here, very comfortable, especially suitable for reading, and quite good.

text: 门口有一点儿吵，请把音量调小一点儿。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr chǎo , qǐng bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yì diǎn ér .
meaning: It is a little noisy at the entrance; please turn the volume down a little.

text: 里面比门口更安静，也比楼上还安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng , yě bǐ lóu shàng hái ān jìng .
meaning: Inside is quieter than the entrance and even quieter than upstairs.

text: 门口不如里面安静，楼上有里面这么安静吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , lóu shàng yǒu lǐ miàn zhè me ān jìng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is not as quiet as inside; is upstairs as quiet as inside?

text: 我只喝水，只有一个人喝茶。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ hē shuǐ , zhǐ yǒu yī gè rén hē chá .
meaning: I drink only water; only one person drinks tea.

text: 大多数人吃米饭，不能说所有人都吃米饭。
pinyin: dà duō shù rén chī mǐ fàn , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu chī mǐ fàn .
meaning: Most people eat rice; that does not mean everyone does.

text: 两份米饭和一份鱼，先确认配料。
pinyin: liǎng fèn mǐ fàn hé yī fèn yú , xiān què rèn pèi liào .
meaning: Two portions of rice and one fish dish: confirm the ingredients first.

text: 我的那份米饭不要油，清淡的菜先上。
pinyin: wǒ de nà fèn mǐ fàn bú yào yóu , qīng dàn de cài xiān shàng .
meaning: Do not add oil to my rice portion; serve the lightly seasoned dishes first.

text: 我一直在站台等，车忽然停了。
pinyin: wǒ yì zhí zài zhàn tái děng , chē hū rán tíng le .
meaning: I have been waiting at the stop all along; the vehicle suddenly stopped.

text: 都七点了，他七点才到，大家已经等了一会儿。
pinyin: dōu qī diǎn le , tā qī diǎn cái dào , dà jiā yǐ jīng děng le yī huì er .
meaning: It is already seven; he did not arrive until seven and everyone has already waited a while.

text: 今天就三个人，三个座位正好。
pinyin: jīn tiān jiù sān gè rén , sān gè zuò wèi zhèng hǎo .
meaning: Today there are only three people; three seats are exactly enough.

pinyin: tiān wǎn le , gāi huí jiā le .
meaning: It is late; it is time to go home.

text: 该发消息了，还没有发出去。
pinyin: gāi fā xiāo xī le , hái méi yǒu fā chū qù .
meaning: It is time to send the message; it has not gone through yet.

text: 我又走错了，明天再看新地址。
pinyin: wǒ yòu zǒu cuò le , míng tiān zài kàn xīn dì zhǐ .
meaning: I went the wrong way again; tomorrow I will check the new address again.

text: 你老看旧图片，老是走错入口。
pinyin: nǐ lǎo kàn jiù tú piàn , lǎo shì zǒu cuò rù kǒu .
meaning: You keep looking at the old image and repeatedly take the wrong entrance.

text: 先看地址，再出门，然后确认入口。
pinyin: xiān kàn dì zhǐ , zài chū mén , rán hòu què rèn rù kǒu .
meaning: Check the address first, then go out, then confirm the entrance.

text: 先还书，接着借书，接下来交作业。
pinyin: xiān huán shū , jiē zhe jiè shū , jiē xià lái jiāo zuò yè .
meaning: Return books, then borrow books, then hand in homework.

text: 手机一开机，就能看到新消息。
pinyin: shǒu jī yī kāi jī , jiù néng kàn dào xīn xiāo xī .
meaning: New messages can be seen as soon as the phone is switched on.

text: 一确认入口，我们就进去。
pinyin: yī què rèn rù kǒu , wǒ men jiù jìn qù .
meaning: We will go in as soon as the entrance is confirmed.

text: 入口就在东边，不在北门。
pinyin: rù kǒu jiù zài dōng biān , bù zài běi mén .
meaning: The entrance is right on the east side, not at the north gate.

text: 我就想确认时间，没有别的要求。
pinyin: wǒ jiù xiǎng què rèn shí jiān , méi yǒu bié de yāo qiú .
meaning: I only want to confirm the time; I have no other request.

text: 我明白，你提的就是时间问题。
pinyin: wǒ míng bái , nǐ tí de jiù shì shí jiān wèn tí .
meaning: I understand: the issue you raised is precisely the time.

text: 对，我明白你的意思，但还没同意这个安排。
pinyin: duì , wǒ míng bái nǐ de yì si , dàn hái méi tóng yì zhè gè ān pái .
meaning: Yes, I understand what you mean, but I have not agreed to the arrangement yet.

pinyin: tā gù yì bù huí xiāo xī .
meaning: He deliberately does not reply to the messages.

text: 他不是故意不回，手机没信号。
pinyin: tā bù shì gù yì bù huí , shǒu jī méi xìn hào .
meaning: His failure to reply is not deliberate; his phone has no signal.

text: 你不太喜欢这个话题吧？
pinyin: nǐ bù tài xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí ba ?
meaning: You do not really like this topic, do you?

pinyin: bù shì , wǒ shì rèn zhēn de .
meaning: No, I am serious.

text: 他点头是不是表示同意？
pinyin: tā diǎn tóu shì bú shì biǎo shì tóng yì ?
meaning: Does his nod mean agreement?

text: 你不喜欢这个话题，是不是？
pinyin: nǐ bù xǐ huān zhè gè huà tí , shì bú shì ?
meaning: You do not like this topic, is that right?

text: 两条路差不多远，好像都能走。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo lù chà bu duō yuǎn , hǎo xiàng dōu néng zǒu .
meaning: The two routes are about equally far; it looks as though both are usable.

text: 也许下雨，时间一确认，我一定告诉你。
pinyin: yě xǔ xià yǔ , shí jiān yī què rèn , wǒ yí dìng gào sù nǐ .
meaning: It may rain; once the time is confirmed, I will definitely tell you.

pinyin: xià yǔ de huà , jiù huàn dào fàn guǎn .
meaning: If it rains, change to the restaurant.

text: 天晴就在公园见，时间不变。
pinyin: tiān qíng jiù zài gōng yuán jiàn , shí jiān bù biàn .
meaning: If it is clear, meet at the park; the time stays the same.

text: 只要场地开着，我们就按计划见。
pinyin: zhǐ yào chǎng dì kāi zhe , wǒ men jiù àn jì huà jiàn .
meaning: As long as the venue is open, we will meet according to plan.

text: 只要先发消息，就不用一直等。
pinyin: zhǐ yào xiān fā xiāo xī , jiù bù yòng yì zhí děng .
meaning: As long as we message first, we need not keep waiting.

pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì dāng fù zé rén ma ?
meaning: Would you like to be the person responsible?

text: 我可以当组长，但先说明规则。
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ dāng zǔ zhǎng , dàn xiān shuō míng guī zé .
meaning: I can act as leader, but first explain the rules.

pinyin: dà jiā jǔ shǒu wèn wèn tí .
meaning: Everyone raises a hand to ask questions.

text: 队长先说明规则，再进行练习。
pinyin: duì zhǎng xiān shuō míng guī zé , zài jìn xíng liàn xí .
meaning: The captain first explains the rules, then carries out practice.

pinyin: wǒ wǎng gōng yuán zǒu , hái méi yǒu dào .
meaning: I am walking towards the park and have not arrived yet.

text: 往前走五十米，再问入口。
pinyin: wǎng qián zǒu wǔ shí mǐ , zài wèn rù kǒu .
meaning: Walk forward fifty metres, then ask about the entrance.

pinyin: xiàng lǎo shī wèn lù .
meaning: Ask the teacher for directions.

text: 向东看，公园在学校对面。
pinyin: xiàng dōng kàn , gōng yuán zài xué xiào duì miàn .
meaning: Look east; the park is opposite the school.

text: 从他说的话看，他还没有确认时间。
pinyin: cóng tā shuō de huà kàn , tā hái méi yǒu què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: Judging from what he says, he has not confirmed the time yet.

text: 我们是在活动上认识的。
pinyin: wǒ men shì zài huó dòng shàng rèn shi de .
meaning: We met at an event.

text: 是朋友介绍的，我是坐车来的。
pinyin: shì péng you jiè shào de , wǒ shì zuò chē lái de .
meaning: A friend introduced us; I came by vehicle.

pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lín Ān.
meaning: Hello! I’m Lin An.

pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ māma.
meaning: This is my mum.

pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de mǎ.
meaning: This is my horse.

pinyin: Wǒ de mǎ bú dà, tā hěn xiǎo.
meaning: My horse isn’t big. It’s very small.

pinyin: Nǐ yǒu mǎ ma?
meaning: Do you have a horse?

text: 你好！我是林安。这是我妈妈。这是我的马。我的马不大，它很小。你有马吗？
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lín Ān. Zhè shì wǒ māma. Zhè shì wǒ de mǎ. Wǒ de mǎ bú dà, tā hěn xiǎo. Nǐ yǒu mǎ ma?
meaning: Hello! I’m Lin An. This is my mum. This is my horse. My horse isn’t big. It’s very small. Do you have a horse?

pinyin: Shān shang yǒu rén.
meaning: There are people on the mountain.

pinyin: Shān xià yǒu shuǐ.
meaning: There is water below the mountain.

pinyin: Wǒ kàn shān, shān hěn dà.
meaning: I look at the mountain. It is big.

pinyin: Tāmen zài shān shang xiūxi.
meaning: They are resting on the mountain.

pinyin: Shān shang yǒu rén. Shān xià yǒu shuǐ. Wǒ kàn shān, shān hěn dà. Tāmen zài shān shang xiūxi.
meaning: There are people on the mountain. There is water below the mountain. I look at the mountain. It is big. They are resting on the mountain.

山下有水。

meaning: He’s my friend. His name is Daming.

meaning: She is Daming’s mum.

text: 大明说中文，他妈妈也说中文。
pinyin: Dàmíng shuō Zhōngwén, tā māma yě shuō Zhōngwén.
meaning: Daming speaks Chinese, and so does his mum.

meaning: She talks fast. I can’t follow.

text: 我问她：“可以说慢一点吗？”
pinyin: Wǒ wèn tā: “Kěyǐ shuō màn yìdiǎn ma?”
meaning: I ask her, “Could you speak a little slower?”

text: 他是我朋友，他叫大明。她是大明的妈妈。大明说中文，他妈妈也说中文。她说话很快，我听不懂。我问她：“可以说慢一点吗？”
pinyin: Tā shì wǒ péngyou, tā jiào Dàmíng. Tā shì Dàmíng de māma. Dàmíng shuō Zhōngwén, tā māma yě shuō Zhōngwén. Tā shuōhuà hěn kuài, wǒ tīng bu dǒng. Wǒ wèn tā: “Kěyǐ shuō màn yìdiǎn ma?”
meaning: He’s my friend. His name is Daming. She is Daming’s mum. Daming speaks Chinese, and so does his mum. She talks fast. I can’t follow. I ask her, “Could you speak a little slower?”

她是大明的妈妈。

pinyin: Lín Ān, nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma?
meaning: Lin An, are you free tomorrow?

pinyin: Yǒu kòng. Nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
meaning: I am. What do you want to do?

pinyin: Wǒmen qù hē chá ba.
meaning: Let’s go for tea.

pinyin: Hǎo a! Míngtiān jiàn.
meaning: Sure! See you tomorrow.

text: 林安，你明天有空吗？有空。你想做什么？我们去喝茶吧。好啊！明天见。
pinyin: Lín Ān, nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma? Yǒu kòng. Nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme? Wǒmen qù hē chá ba. Hǎo a! Míngtiān jiàn.
meaning: Lin An, are you free tomorrow? I am. What do you want to do? Let’s go for tea. Sure! See you tomorrow.

有空。你想做什么？
我们去喝茶吧。

pinyin: Yǒu rén zài ménkǒu.
meaning: Someone is at the door.

pinyin: Wǒ wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi?”
meaning: I ask, “Who are you?”

text: 他说：“我是你的朋友大明！”
pinyin: Tā shuō: “Wǒ shì nǐ de péngyou Dàmíng!”
meaning: He says, “I’m your friend Daming!”

pinyin: Wǒ kàn le kàn, shì Dàmíng.
meaning: I take a look. It is Daming.

pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn le.
meaning: We went to eat together.

text: 有人在门口。我问：“你是谁？”他说：“我是你的朋友大明！”我看了看，是大明。我们一起去吃饭了。
pinyin: Yǒu rén zài ménkǒu. Wǒ wèn: “Nǐ shì shéi?” Tā shuō: “Wǒ shì nǐ de péngyou Dàmíng!” Wǒ kàn le kàn, shì Dàmíng. Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn le.
meaning: Someone is at the door. I ask, “Who are you?” He says, “I’m your friend Daming!” I take a look. It is Daming. We went to eat together.

我问：“你是谁？”

pinyin: Ānnà, shēngrì kuàilè!
meaning: Anna, happy birthday!

pinyin: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì?
meaning: It's your birthday today?

pinyin: Duì, jīntiān sān yuè bā hào.
meaning: Yes, it's March 8th.

pinyin: Shēngrì kuàilè! Nǐ jīnnián duō dà?
meaning: Happy birthday! How old are you?

pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián èrshíwǔ suì. Nǐ ne?
meaning: Twenty-five. And you?

text: 我二十七。这是我们送你的。
pinyin: Wǒ èrshíqī. Zhè shì wǒmen sòng nǐ de.
meaning: Twenty-seven. This is from us.

pinyin: Shì dàngāo! Xièxie nǐmen!
meaning: A cake! Thank you!

pinyin: Lái, wǒmen yìqǐ chī ba!
meaning: Come on, let's eat it together!

text: 安娜，生日快乐！今天是你的生日？对，今天三月八号。生日快乐！你今年多大？我今年二十五岁。你呢？我二十七。这是我们送你的。是蛋糕！谢谢你们！来，我们一起吃吧！
pinyin: Ānnà, shēngrì kuàilè! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì? Duì, jīntiān sān yuè bā hào. Shēngrì kuàilè! Nǐ jīnnián duō dà? Wǒ jīnnián èrshíwǔ suì. Nǐ ne? Wǒ èrshíqī. Zhè shì wǒmen sòng nǐ de. Shì dàngāo! Xièxie nǐmen! Lái, wǒmen yìqǐ chī ba!
meaning: Anna, happy birthday! It's your birthday today? Yes, it's March 8th. Happy birthday! How old are you? Twenty-five. And you? Twenty-seven. This is from us. A cake! Thank you! Come on, let's eat it together!

今天是你的生日？
对，今天三月八号。
生日快乐！你今年多大？
我今年二十五岁。你呢？
我二十七。这是我们送你的。
是蛋糕！谢谢你们！

pinyin: Xīngqīliù shì Ānnà de shēngrì!
meaning: Saturday is Anna's birthday!

text: 我们晚上七点在我家吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒmen wǎnshang qī diǎn zài wǒ jiā chīfàn.
meaning: We'll have dinner at my place at seven.

meaning: Great! Should we buy a cake?

meaning: I'll get the cake; you get flowers.

pinyin: yī bǎi èr shí fēn chéng sān fèn , zhèng hǎo měi rén sì shí . jīn tiān měi rén huā sì shí kuài .
meaning: Divide one hundred and twenty into three shares: exactly forty each. Each person spends forty today.

text: 收入不多也可以先定预算。这次一百五十够付，付完还剩三十。
pinyin: shōu rù bù duō yě kě yǐ xiān dìng yù suàn . zhè cì yī bǎi wǔ shí gòu fù , fù wán hái shèng sān shí .
meaning: Even with a modest income we can set a budget. One hundred and fifty is enough, leaving thirty after payment.

text: 店里卖水果，我们买一公斤，也就是两斤。五角是半块钱。
pinyin: diàn lǐ mài shuǐ guǒ , wǒ men mǎi yī gōng jīn , yě jiù shì liǎng jīn . wǔ jiǎo shì bàn kuài qián .
meaning: The shop sells fruit; we buy one kilogram, or two jin. Five jiao is half a yuan.

text: 我带了银行卡和现金，卡能不能用，还要问店里。
pinyin: wǒ dài le yín háng kǎ hé xiàn jīn , kǎ néng bù néng yòng , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ .
meaning: I brought a bank card and cash; I still need to ask whether the shop accepts the card.

text: 一千、一万、一亿是练习读数字，不是今天的费用。要买的东西不少，但没有花一万。
pinyin: yī qiān , yī wàn , yī yì shì liàn xí dú shù zì , bù shì jīn tiān de fèi yòng . yào mǎi de dōng xi bù shǎo , dàn méi yǒu huā yī wàn .
meaning: One thousand, ten thousand and a hundred million are number-reading practice, not today’s cost. We buy quite a few things but do not spend ten thousand.

text: 十多个人是概数，一个多小时也是概数。记账时，不能拿它们代替准确的总数。
pinyin: shí duō gè rén shì gài shǔ , yī gè duō xiǎo shí yě shì gài shǔ . jì zhàng shí , bù néng ná tā men dài tì zhǔn què de zǒng shù .

text: 包裹先放下吧。你写了几封信？
pinyin: bāo guǒ xiān fàng xià ba . nǐ xiě le jǐ fēng xìn ?
meaning: Put the parcel down first. How many letters did you write?

text: 两封。一封给照顾我的朋友，一封给老师。
pinyin: liǎng fēng . yī fēng gěi zhào gù wǒ de péng you , yī fēng gěi lǎo shī .
meaning: Two. One for the friend who looked after me and one for the teacher.

pinyin: nà wèi péng you zhù sān céng , duì ma ?
meaning: That friend lives on the third floor, right?

text: 对，但这个包裹送到学校。地址在笔记本里。
pinyin: duì , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào . dì zhǐ zài bǐ jì běn lǐ .
meaning: Yes, but this parcel goes to the school. The address is in my notebook.

text: 纸和笔在这儿。你准备了什么礼物？
pinyin: zhǐ hé bǐ zài zhèr . nǐ zhǔn bèi le shén me lǐ wù ?
meaning: The paper and pen are here. What gifts did you prepare?

text: 一条围巾、一件衣服，还有一套笔记本和笔。
pinyin: yī tiáo wéi jīn , yī jiàn yī fú , hái yǒu yī tào bǐ jì běn hé bǐ .

pinyin: bǐ jì běn hé bǐ . wǒ sòng péng you wéi jīn , yī fú liú gěi zì jǐ .
meaning: The notebooks and pens. I give my friend the scarf and keep the clothing for myself.

pinyin: tā jiē shòu le ma ?
meaning: Has she accepted it?

text: 她说谢谢，还说看了信很感动。我也感谢她的帮助。
pinyin: tā shuō xiè xiè , hái shuō kàn le xìn hěn gǎn dòng . wǒ yě gǎn xiè tā de bāng zhù .

pinyin: xìn yào jiāo gěi shéi ?

text: 交给老师。先确认收件人，再寄，别只看楼层。

text: 接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。

接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。
别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。

text: 地址写好了，就交给快递吧。
pinyin: dì zhǐ xiě hǎo le , jiù jiāo gěi kuài dì ba .
meaning: The address is written; let us give it to the delivery service.

text: 等一下，这张纸上只有学校，没有收件人的名字。
pinyin: děng yī xià , zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng zhǐ yǒu xué xiào , méi yǒu shōu jiàn rén de míng zi .
meaning: Wait: this sheet has only the school name, not the recipient’s name.

text: 我刚才只看三层，忘了补写。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn sān céng , wàng le bǔ xiě .
meaning: I only checked the third floor and forgot to add it.

text: 楼层不是名字。是送给老师的那一份吗？
pinyin: lóu céng bù shì míng zi . shì sòng gěi lǎo shī de nà yī fèn ma ?
meaning: The floor is not a name. Is this the gift for the teacher?

text: 对。写上名字，再检查一遍。
pinyin: duì . xiě shàng míng zi , zài jiǎn chá yī biàn .
meaning: Yes. Add the name and check once more.

text: 这样才清楚。谢谢你照顾我的包裹。
pinyin: zhè yàng cái qīng chǔ . xiè xiè nǐ zhào gù wǒ de bāo guǒ .
meaning: Now it is clear. Thank you for looking after my parcel.

text: 你刚到吗？我早晨看了通知，说六点半集合。
pinyin: nǐ gāng dào ma ? wǒ zǎo chén kàn le tōng zhī , shuō liù diǎn bàn jí hé .
meaning: Did you just arrive? I read a notice this morning saying to meet at half past six.

text: 先停一下。新通知刚刚发来，集合改成六点四十。
pinyin: xiān tíng yī xià . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái , jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí .
meaning: Wait. The new notice has just arrived; the meeting time changed to six forty.

pinyin: jié mù yě gǎi le ma ?
meaning: Did the programme time change too?

text: 没有，还是七点。开场以前先检票，六点四十集合就好。
pinyin: méi yǒu , hái shi qī diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , liù diǎn sì shí jí hé jiù hǎo .
meaning: No, still seven. Tickets are checked before the start; meeting at six forty is fine.

text: 那我们有二十分钟。刚才收到的是什么？
pinyin: nà wǒ men yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng . gāng cái shōu dào de shì shén me ?
meaning: Then we have twenty minutes. What did we receive just now?

text: 刚才是旧的。上周的图片也别当成今天的。
pinyin: gāng cái shì jiù de . shàng zhōu de tú piàn yě bié dàng chéng jīn tiān de .
meaning: That was the old one. Do not treat last week’s image as today’s either.

text: 这时灯还亮着，节目还没开始吧？
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe , jié mù hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
meaning: The lights are still on now; it has not started yet, right?

text: 对，快要七点了。灯暗了以后先别走，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: duì , kuài yào qī diǎn le . dēng àn le yǐ hòu xiān bié zǒu , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: Right, nearly seven. Stay seated after the lights dim; the programme is about to begin.

text: 散场后喝茶？夜里还有车吗？
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá ? yè lǐ hái yǒu chē ma ?
meaning: Tea after the show? Will transport still be running at night?

text: 先确认，别到半夜才问。不一会儿，另一位朋友也会到。
pinyin: xiān què rèn , bié dào bàn yè cái wèn . bù yí huìr , lìng yī wèi péng you yě huì dào .
meaning: Check first; do not wait until midnight to ask. Another friend will arrive shortly too.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期节目不少。下周还有？
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī jié mù bù shǎo . xià zhōu hái yǒu ?
meaning: It is the school’s tenth anniversary; quite a few programmes this term. Another next week?

text: 有，不久以后再发通知。今天先看这一场。
pinyin: yǒu , bù jiǔ yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī . jīn tiān xiān kàn zhè yī chǎng .
meaning: Yes, another notice will be sent before long. Today let us watch this one first.

meaning: The image received just now was old. We only saw the new message afterwards and stopped to check it.

text: 从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。
pinyin: cóng liù diǎn sì shí dào qī diǎn yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , bù shì èr shí diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , zài rù chǎng .
meaning: There are twenty minutes from six forty to seven, not twenty o’clock. Have tickets checked before the start, then enter.

text: 这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe . kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù yào kāi shǐ le , dàn hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The lights are still on now. It is nearly seven and the programme is about to begin, but it has not started yet.

text: 灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
pinyin: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

text: 不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
pinyin: bù yí huìr , péng you yě lái le . wǒ men méi yǒu děng dào bàn yè cái wèn huí jiā de bàn fǎ .
meaning: Our friend arrived in a little while too. We did not wait until the middle of the night to ask how to get home.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng . shàng zhōu qù guò yī cì , xià zhōu hái xiǎng zài qù .
meaning: For the school’s tenth anniversary there is an activity every week this term. We went once last week and want to go again next week.

text: 不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。
pinyin: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu huì fā xià zhōu de tōng zhī . jīn tiān zhè yī zhāng bù néng ná lái què dìng xià zhōu de shí jiān .
meaning: Next week’s notice will be sent before long. Today’s notice cannot establish next week’s times.

一周又一周，朋友还会见。周年有节目，我们慢慢看。

text: 好久没见！你明天也有空儿吗？
pinyin: hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn ! nǐ míng tiān yě yǒu kòngr ma ?
meaning: Long time no see! Are you free tomorrow too?

text: 明天还不知道。今天门口有一点儿响，我们先看里面吧。
pinyin: míng tiān hái bù zhī dào . jīn tiān mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , wǒ men xiān kàn lǐ miàn ba .
meaning: I do not know about tomorrow yet. The entrance is a little loud today; let us check inside first.

text: 里面好多座位，没满。这里比门口更安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn hǎo duō zuò wèi , méi mǎn . zhè lǐ bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng .
meaning: There are many seats inside, not all occupied. It is quieter than the entrance.

text: 挺舒服的，但灯十分亮，我不太喜欢。
pinyin: tǐng shū fú de , dàn dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān .
meaning: Quite comfortable, but the lights are very bright; I do not particularly like that.

text: 后面没有这么亮，也离音箱更远。
pinyin: hòu miàn méi yǒu zhè me liàng , yě lí yīn xiāng gèng yuǎn .
meaning: It is not this bright farther back, and it is farther from the speaker.

text: 好，那边读书的人不少，我们小声说。
pinyin: hǎo , nà biān dú shū de rén bù shǎo , wǒ men xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Good. Quite a few people are reading there; let us speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十，贵十块。费用不超过五十，行吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí , guì shí kuài . fèi yòng bù chāo guò wǔ shí , xíng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is forty and inside fifty, ten more. At most fifty, okay?

text: 行。门口不如里面安静，十块是差价，不是全部。
pinyin: xíng . mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , shí kuài shì chà jià , bù shì quán bù .
meaning: Okay. The entrance is not as quiet as inside. Ten is the difference, not the total.

text: 两边温度不同，里面比门口低三度。
pinyin: liǎng biān wēn dù bù tóng , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù .
meaning: The temperatures differ; inside is three degrees lower than the entrance.

text: 但我没量声音，不能说低了多少分贝。只觉得这里更合适。
pinyin: dàn wǒ méi liáng shēng yīn , bù néng shuō dī le duō shao fēn bèi . zhǐ jué de zhè lǐ gèng hé shì .
meaning: But I did not measure the sound; I cannot say how many decibels lower it is. I only feel it is more suitable.

text: 音箱的声音有点儿难听，要不要再大声说？
pinyin: yīn xiāng de shēng yīn yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , yào bù yào zài dà shēng shuō ?
meaning: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant. Should we speak louder?

text: 不用大声。我听得见，音量小一点点就好。
pinyin: bù yòng dà shēng . wǒ tīng dé jiàn , yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo .
meaning: No need to speak loudly. I can hear; just lower the volume a tiny bit.

text: 我和朋友好久没见。今天见面，明天有没有空儿还不知道。
pinyin: wǒ hé péng you hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn . jīn tiān jiàn miàn , míng tiān yǒu méi yǒu kòngr hái bù zhī dào .
meaning: My friend and I have not met for a long time. We meet today; we do not yet know whether tomorrow is free.

text: 门口有一点儿响，也不够安静。里面更安静，座位还没满。

text: 里面有好多座位，挺舒服的。前面的灯十分亮，我不太喜欢，所以选后面。
pinyin: lǐ miàn yǒu hǎo duō zuò wèi , tǐng shū fú de . qián miàn de dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān , suǒ yǐ xuǎn hòu miàn .
meaning: Inside has many seats and is quite comfortable. The front lights are very bright and I do not particularly like them, so we choose farther back.

text: 后面离音箱远，灯也没有前面这么亮。有人读书，我们就小声说。
pinyin: hòu miàn lí yīn xiāng yuǎn , dēng yě méi yǒu qián miàn zhè me liàng . yǒu rén dú shū , wǒ men jiù xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Farther back is away from the speaker, and the lights are not as bright as at the front. People are reading, so we speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十。里面比门口贵十块，但费用没有超过五十。
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí . lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu guì shí kuài , dàn fèi yòng méi yǒu chāo guò wǔ shí .
meaning: The entrance costs forty and inside fifty. Inside is ten more, but the cost does not exceed fifty.

text: 门口不如里面安静。这是我们的感受，不是测出来的声音数字。
pinyin: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng . zhè shì wǒ men de gǎn shòu , bù shì cè chū lái de shēng yīn shù zì .
meaning: The entrance is not as quiet as inside. This is our impression, not a measured sound figure.

text: 温度表显示，里面比门口低三度。这个三度说的是温度，不是音量。
pinyin: wēn dù biǎo xiǎn shì , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù . zhè gè sān dù shuō de shì wēn dù , bù shì yīn liàng .
meaning: The thermometer shows that inside is three degrees lower than the entrance. These three degrees refer to temperature, not volume.

text: 音箱有点儿难听，不过不用大声说。音量小一点点就好，我们也没有要求别人离开。
pinyin: yīn xiāng yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , bù guò bù yòng dà shēng shuō . yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo , wǒ men yě méi yǒu yāo qiú bié ren lí kāi .
meaning: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant, but there is no need to speak loudly. A tiny reduction in volume is enough; we do not ask anyone to leave.

text: 这里好响啊！是不是比门口低三分贝？

meaning: It is so loud here! Is it three decibels lower than at the entrance?

text: 三度说的是温度，我没有量声音。
pinyin: sān dù shuō de shì wēn dù , wǒ méi yǒu liáng shēng yīn .
meaning: Three degrees refers to temperature. I did not measure the sound.

pinyin: nà zěn me shuō ?
meaning: Then how should I put it?

text: 说有一点儿响就好。你想小一点儿，可以直接问。
pinyin: shuō yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng jiù hǎo . nǐ xiǎng xiǎo yì diǎn ér , kě yǐ zhí jiē wèn .
meaning: Just say it is a little loud. If you want it quieter, you can ask directly.

text: 这样清楚多了。我们也小声说吧。
pinyin: zhè yàng qīng chǔ duō le . wǒ men yě xiǎo shēng shuō ba .
meaning: That is much clearer. Let us speak quietly too.

text: 这里好响啊！是不是比门口低三分贝？三度说的是温度，我没有量声音。那怎么说？说有一点儿响就好。你想小一点儿，可以直接问。请把音量调小一点儿，可以吗？这样清楚多了。我们也小声说吧。

pinyin: rén shù què rèn le ma ?
meaning: Have we confirmed the number of people?

text: 全到了，一共四个人。这张桌子只能坐四个，正好。
pinyin: quán dào le , yī gòng sì gè rén . zhè zhāng zhuō zi zhǐ néng zuò sì gè , zhèng hǎo .
meaning: Everyone is here, four in total. This table seats only four, exactly enough.

text: 我今天请客，先问所有人想吃什么。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān qǐng kè , xiān wèn suǒ yǒu rén xiǎng chī shén me .
meaning: I am treating today; let us first ask everyone what they want.

text: 大多数人想吃米饭，少数不想要。不能替其他人决定。
pinyin: dà duō shù rén xiǎng chī mǐ fàn , shǎo shù bù xiǎng yào . bù néng tì qí tā rén jué dìng .
meaning: The majority want rice and a few do not. We cannot decide for the others.

text: 具体是谁？全体组员都看菜单了吗？
pinyin: jù tǐ shì shéi ? quán tǐ zǔ yuán dōu kàn cài dān le ma ?
meaning: Who specifically? Has every group member looked at the menu?

text: 三个人要饭，一个不要。其中一个只喝水，另外三个人喝茶。
pinyin: sān gè rén yào fàn , yī gè bú yào . qí zhōng yī gè zhǐ hē shuǐ , lìng wài sān gè rén hē chá .
meaning: Three want rice and one does not. One drinks only water and the other three drink tea.

text: 鸡和鱼都可以吗？有蛋吗？
pinyin: jī hé yú dōu kě yǐ ma ? yǒu dàn ma ?
meaning: Are chicken and fish both okay? Is there egg?

text: 先问配料。我没完全看懂，也不能猜过敏的人能不能吃。
pinyin: xiān wèn pèi liào . wǒ méi wán quán kàn dǒng , yě bù néng cāi guò mǐn de rén néng bù néng chī .
meaning: Ask about ingredients first. I have not fully understood it and cannot guess whether someone with an allergy can eat it.

text: 菜单写二两米饭，是两份吗？
pinyin: cài dān xiě èr liǎng mǐ fàn , shì liǎng fèn ma ?
meaning: The menu says two liang of rice; is that two portions?

text: 不是，两是分量单位，份是份数。先问店里一份是多少。
pinyin: bù shì , liǎng shì fèn liàng dān wèi , fèn shì fèn shǔ . xiān wèn diàn lǐ yī fèn shì duō shao .
meaning: No, liang is a weight unit and fen counts portions. Ask the restaurant how much a portion is.

text: 油少一点儿，菜先上一部分。我吃饱了就不加饭。
pinyin: yóu shǎo yì diǎn ér , cài xiān shàng yī bù fèn . wǒ chī bǎo le jiù bù jiā fàn .
meaning: A little less oil, and serve some dishes first. Once I am full, I will not add rice.

text: 好。大家觉得公平就好，不用因为请客就多点。下次朋友全家来也先问。
pinyin: hǎo . dà jiā jué de gōng píng jiù hǎo , bù yòng yīn wèi qǐng kè jiù duō diǎn . xià cì péng you quán jiā lái yě xiān wèn .

text: 刚才车忽然停了。司机说交通不顺利，路口的车辆很多。

text: 我有点儿急。朋友说快点儿，我还是先看安全，不让司机开快。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér jí . péng you shuō kuài diǎnr , wǒ hái shi xiān kàn ān quán , bù ràng sī jī kāi kuài .
meaning: I am anxious. My friend says to hurry, but I still prioritize safety and do not ask the driver to speed up.

text: 停车场离学校近，但停车场不是公交站。我等到车停好才下，不在路边下。
pinyin: tíng chē chǎng lí xué xiào jìn , dàn tíng chē chǎng bù shì gōng jiāo zhàn . wǒ děng dào chē tíng hǎo cái xià , bù zài lù biān xià .
meaning: The car park is near the school but is not the bus stop. I wait until the vehicle stops properly to get off, not by the roadside.

text: 我一直没有离开车。站台的位置还要看清楚，不能只看距离近。

text: 看手表，已经七点了。手机信号不好，第一条消息可能没有发出去。

text: 到达时间还没确认，我不说一定七点到。时间一确认，就发消息。
